title: Maximum Erasure Value

solutions.optimal:
class Solution:
    def maximumUniqueSubarray(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        seen = set()
        left = 0
        total = 0
        ans = 0
        for x in nums:
            while x in seen:
                seen.remove(nums[left])
                total -= nums[left]
                left += 1
            seen.add(x)
            total += x
            ans = max(ans, total)
        return ans
